Name: Fluffy Clint - Seasonal
Author: L00MZIE
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]An aesthetic mod that serves to reimagine Clint's look as Pelican Town's blacksmith [/color]
BTW - This is my first mod so it is still in need of polishing, the current version may have one or two bugs unaccounted for that will be fixed in future versions.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A revamp of Clint's portraits and sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url]. Now less of a weird...guy (still is) but now hot! The mod expands on adding outfits for all eight festivals with three variations of his facial hair to choose from. Spirits Eve outfits have their own unique variation depending on the config you choose which you can view in Images for details.[/color]

- At the moment this mod only includes a facial hair toggle, though more toggles will be added to disable seasonal/festival outfits for a more Vanilla feel.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Be sure to have Content Patcher downloaded!  This mod is meant to be an [i]add-on[/i] to mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url], but is[b] not required [/b]for the mod to work. [/color]
This mod may have conflicts with other Clint asset mods or any mod that changes his appearance.
___
[b]Mods used in images: [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28933][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28933]Farmer Portraits - Seasonal Emotional Festivals[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17272]Seasonal UI[/url], 

[b]Version: 1.0.1[/b]
- fixed config not showing up in GMCM
- fixed his goatee spring portrait showing errors in SMAPI log
